name: Rampart 20x Playground
initializeCommand: cd .devcontainer && touch .codespace-secret-key tap-codespace.env && chmod 666 .codespace-secret-key tap-codespace.env && { [ -s .env ] || printf 'POSTGRES_PASSWORD=%s\nTAP_SEARCH_READONLY_PASSWORD=%s\n' "$(openssl rand -hex 24)" "$(openssl rand -hex 24)" > .env; }
postAttachCommand: echo 'Starting the 20x Playground. A new Codespace takes about eight minutes. This terminal prints the link when the site is ready.'; n=0; until curl -s -o /dev/null --max-time 3 http://127.0.0.1:8000/ || [ "$n" -ge 240 ]; do n=$((n+1)); sleep 5; done; if [ "$n" -ge 240 ]; then echo 'The site did not start within 20 minutes. Please report it: https://github.com/unified-systems-com/rampart-20x-playground-tap/issues'; else echo; echo "The 20x Playground is ready: https://$CODESPACE_NAME-8000.$GITHUB_CODESPACES_PORT_FORWARDING_DOMAIN"; echo 'Open that link, then sign in with the GitHub account that opened this Codespace.'; fi
